focus_areas: Integrity of pectoral fin rays (check for fusion/melting)
Spatial separation of fin tips from background reef (bleeding check)
Consistency of stripe patterns across body curvature
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tips of the pectoral fin rays. In AI images, these often dissolve into the background or merge with adjacent rays. Use the geometric depth auditor to confirm they are in front of the reef. Verify if the red/white stripes follow the body's 3D curvature logically or if they appear painted on flatly. Distinguish between camera motion blur and AI 'smearing' artifacts, particularly in the background textures.
image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming near a reef. The fish exhibits characteristic red and white vertical stripes. Its large, fan-like pectoral fins are spread wide, showing elongated rays that appear semi-translucent. The dorsal spines are visible rising from the back. The background consists of dark, textured reef structures with some lighting reflections on the water surface or glass.
